title: Render PNG thumbnails of library symbols and footprints
summary: Opens every SchLib and PcbLib in a folder and saves a PNG image of each symbol and footprint with the SDK thumbnail renderers. Shows the late-bound workaround for the Paint methods' handle overflow and how to leave user-opened libraries alone.
phrasings: generate preview pictures of schematic symbols
save a picture of every component in a library

commands.name: GenerateThumbnails
commands.description: Render PNG thumbnails of every symbol and footprint in library folders
commands.params: SchFolder=<folder with .SchLib files>|PcbFolder=<folder with .PcbLib files> (at least one)|Out=<folder> (default: %TEMP%\LibraryThumbnailImages)|SchSize=<pixels 1-4096> (default 2000)|PcbSize=<pixels 1-4096> (default 500)
